transcript.reasoning:
Link loss increased from 3.67 dB to 4.98 dB ~1.31 dB extra loss. Could be connector dirty/damaged, bad splice, macrobend, fibre break. Site notes: patching at site B ODF on 2026-10-18 23:33, right before degradation start 2026-10-19. Could be connector issue at B-ODF. Also flooding near km 11 on 2026-10-22, after degradation start but could cause macrobend.

We have attenuator loss 10.13 dB slightly high. Might be wrong attenuator? Design 10 dB. Measured 10.13 dB, within tolerance? Could be 10 dB nominal with tolerance.

Need inspect connectors. Inspect A-ODF, B-ODF, and maybe MID-PP? Link record shows no MID-PP. Elements are A-ODF, SC-01, SC-02, SC-03, SC-04, B-ODF. No MID-PP.
